verdict.rationale: cfo.ai ships a built-in AI assistant, Ari, that takes delegated tasks inside the product. Users can ask it to rebuild a workbook as a live Model, run one-line scenarios, sync sources, add or remove synced tables, and draft board decks. It also acts proactively and under per-tool allow/ask/deny approval policies, with undoable writes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Ari's delegated task execution works as documented.
